summary:
FlexJobs released its Q3 2026 Remote Work Index, reporting a 33% quarter-over-quarter increase in fully remote job postings, the third consecutive quarter of growth. The index analyzed remote postings from more than 60,000 companies in the FlexJobs database between July 1 and September 30, 2026, tracking trends by industry, career field, employer, and occupation.

By total posting volume, Project Management remained the largest remote career field, followed by Computer & IT, Sales, Operations, and Business Development. Growth rates varied widely by field. The fastest growing categories were Operations (+52%), Customer Service (+47%), Project Management (+44%), Engineering (+41%), and Business Development (+41%). The slowest growing were Education & Training (+19%), Medical & Health (+29%), Communications (+31%), Sales (+34%), and Account Management (+35%).

Healthcare and tech employers drove much of the activity. Top employers posting remote roles included Everforth, UnitedHealth Group, Actalent, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Humana, General Electric, Allstate, CVS Health, Abbott Laboratories, and JLL.

By career level, postings skewed toward experienced and leadership talent: Experienced 63%, Manager 21%, Senior Manager 10%, and Entry Level just 6%.

Keith Spencer, Career Expert at FlexJobs, framed the data as a counterpoint to return-to-office messaging, saying that despite the noise about RTO mandates, the jobs data tells a different story, and that three consecutive quarters of remote growth show work-from-home careers remain a differentiator. He argued employers tapping remote talent in operations and project management are positioning themselves to build stronger teams.

The release notes FlexJobs has been used by over 135 million people since 2007 and specializes in flexible, hybrid, and remote listings, also working with companies to recruit remote talent and optimize flexible workplace programs. Media contact and methodology details are included.
